summary: Recent updates to the WebRTC test suite focused on improving the reliability of the test for setting audio parameters in peer-to-peer connections. The patch aims to address intermittent failures, which can lead to confusion and hinder developers' ability to ensure proper functionality in video calls and real-time communications powered by WebRTC. By stabilizing these tests, it helps reinforce the reliability of audio settings, ensuring that users experience clearer and more consistent audio during their calls. **This is crucial for maintaining user trust in communication applications that rely on WebRTC.**
